_note: Faculty classification for the UI. Rule set by the founder (2026-10-30): the app manifest keeps every faculty and department the founder asked for; any faculty the NUC lists as a faculty also becomes a faculty. authority = founder-manifest (asked for by the founder) or nuc (listed by the NUC, added under the rule). roster_pending = departments that belong in the faculty but have not been researched yet (names only, no course lists). open = items still awaiting evidence.

faculties.name: Allied Medical Sciences
decided: nursing-science: the NUC places Nursing Sciences under Allied Health Sciences, so it stays here.

faculties.name: Pharmacy
decided: Pharmacy is a faculty in its own right: the NUC publishes it as its own discipline and almost every Nigerian university runs it as a faculty.

faculties.name: Sciences
open: biochemistry and microbiology: universities split between Sciences and Applied/Life Sciences.

medical-physics: no undergraduate course list found; year 1 assumed from the science core and the year-4 rows derived from UNN's postgraduate list. Replace when a sponsor supplies the university's own table.

faculties.name: Banking and Finance
open: economics: not confirmed in the NUC list read so far. Left here under the founder manifest; move only if the NUC list shows a Social Sciences faculty.
faculties.nuc_note: The NUC groups Insurance, Accounting and Finance under Administration and Management. The founder manifest name Banking and Finance is kept for the app.

faculties.name: Linguistics
faculties.nuc_note: The NUC lists Linguistics under Arts and Humanities. The founder manifest keeps it as its own faculty.

faculties.name: Law
decided: Law is a faculty in its own right in the NUC curriculum and in the app.

cross_cutting.name: General Studies
cross_cutting.note: University-wide core (GST/ENT). Shown to every student; not a faculty a student enrols in.
